title: Daily-mean flood screening: Fish River, Maine

problem: Screen the 100-year daily-mean flood at Fish River, Maine; identify estimator uncertainty and limitations.
headline: Screen the 100-year daily-mean flood at Fish River, Maine; identify estimator uncertainty and limitations: 100-year return level, GEV (L-moments) 463.9 m3/s (established).
